title: The Corner Kick — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The corner kick is hope compressed into an arc
Eleven men moving into the box
With entirely different ideas about where the ball is going to land

[Verse 2 — Español]
El saque de esquina corto es una filosofía completamente diferente [The short corner is a different philosophy entirely]
El saque de esquina corto dice — hemos pensado en esto [The short corner says — we've thought about this]
El saque de esquina corto dice — no queremos caos [The short corner says — we don't want chaos]
Queremos un ángulo [We want an angle]
La multitud gruñe ante el saque de esquina corto [The crowd groans at the short corner]
Porque vinieron por el caos [Because they came for the chaos]
Y no lo obtuvieron [And they didn't get it]

[Chorus — English]
The corner says — everyone into the box
The corner says — near post flick-on, second ball
Somewhere between all of those instructions the ball arrives
And two very large men jump at the same time

[Bridge — Français]
Chas adorait le corner [Chas loved the corner kick]
Il disait — c'est le seul moment dans le football [He said — it's the only moment in football]
Où le chaos est officiellement prévu [Where chaos is officially scheduled]
Où les règles disent — oui, maintenant, tout le monde y va [Where the rules say — yes, now, everybody go]
Et voyons ce qui se passe [And see what happens]

[Verse 3 — English]
The short corner says we want an angle
The crowd came for the chaos — and they didn't get it

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The corner kick
El saque de esquina [The corner kick]
Le corner [The corner kick]
That's my boy
